app_documentation:
The Flower Delivery App is a modern e-commerce platform designed to streamline the process of browsing, purchasing, and receiving fresh flower arrangements. Built with React for the frontend and Node.js/Express for the backend, the application provides a seamless shopping experience across web and mobile platforms. The app features an elegant, nature-inspired design with a clean interface that prioritizes visual product discovery through high-quality imagery and intuitive navigation.

The primary purpose of the Flower Delivery App is to connect customers with a curated selection of flower arrangements while providing real-time order tracking and delivery management. Main features include a comprehensive flower catalog with category-based browsing, a robust shopping cart system with promo code support, secure checkout with Stripe payment integration, real-time order tracking with Google Maps API integration, and user account management with saved addresses and payment methods. The application also includes an administrative interface for inventory management, allowing administrators to add new products, update stock levels, and manage pricing.

The app serves three distinct user roles: Customers who browse and purchase flower arrangements, Administrators who manage the flower catalog and inventory, and Delivery Drivers who fulfill orders and update delivery status. The platform is optimized for mobile-first experiences while maintaining full functionality on desktop web browsers, ensuring accessibility and usability across all devices.

Technical implementation leverages PostgreSQL for data persistence with a well-structured schema including users, flowers, orders, order_items, and delivery_assignments tables. The system supports same-day delivery options, gift messaging, delivery time slot selection, and comprehensive order history tracking. Security is prioritized through password hashing, secure payment processing via Stripe, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance to ensure the application is usable by all customers.

glossary.Order Status: The current state of a customer order in the fulfillment pipeline. Valid statuses include Pending (order received but not yet processed), Processing (order being prepared), Out for Delivery (assigned to driver and in transit), Delivered (successfully completed), and Cancelled (order terminated before completion).
glossary.Payment Status: The state of payment processing for an order. Valid statuses include Pending (payment not yet processed), Completed (payment successfully captured), Failed (payment processing error occurred), and Refunded (payment returned to customer).
glossary.Stock Quantity: The current available inventory count for a specific flower arrangement in the catalog. This value is decremented when orders are placed and updated by administrators through the inventory management interface. When stock reaches zero, the flower displays as out of stock to customers.
glossary.Delivery Assignment: The association between a specific order and a delivery driver responsible for fulfillment. Each order can only have one active delivery assignment at a time, tracking timestamps for when the driver was assigned, picked up the order, and completed delivery.
glossary.User Role: The permission level and functional access granted to a user account. The three roles are Customer (can browse and purchase flowers), Administrator (can manage inventory and view all orders), and Delivery Driver (can view assigned deliveries and update delivery status).
glossary.Baseline Artifact: A versioned snapshot of project documentation or specifications that serves as a reference point for project state, change management, and support governance. Baseline artifacts are immutable records used to track project evolution and maintain consistency across development cycles.
